messages:
mike.h: Pushed routing-v2 (canary -> 25%) to prod. Kicking off post-deploy smoke and synth probes for EU first. Will watch p95 and KV warmup.

deploy-bot: [deploy] routing-v2 rollout started for prod at 2026-03-23T12:00Z. Canary=25% -> metrics stream: /deploys/1776543211 (logs + synth).

alisha: Seeing an EU fanout synth spike ~+3m after canary start — p95 ~380ms (baseline ~95ms). Fail rate tiny but tail latency up. Traces show extra KV misses on fanout path (trace id abc123).

mike.h: Running quick healthcheck:
```
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API' https://eu.api.redwood/v1/_health | jq .
# latency: 0.38s, kv_miss_rate: 0.12
```

sara: Hmm. If KV prefill isn't hitting, fanout will blow tail. Suggest we pin EU traffic back to routing-v1 while we triage. Can we set a fallback policy: if p95>300ms -> fallback to v1?

opsbot: Dry-run pin queued: eu-west1 25% -> routing-v1 (dry). To promote to 100% run `/ops pin promote 1776543211 eu-west1`.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot: cpu stable, queue depth +12% vs baseline, synth fail_rate 0.6% (baseline 0.05%), kv_miss_rate x6.

alisha: Confirming KV miss spike correlates with route to new embedding shim. Could be mismatch in prefill TTL or async prefill worker lag. I can triage logs but need routing pinned to avoid customer impact.

sara: I vote to pause global rollout and roll EU back to v1 now. @mike.h can you approve quick pin/rollback? We should also add a note to release notes about possible prefill regression.

mike.h: Approved. Pausing remaining regions' rollouts. Promoting the dry-run pin to immediate rollback for eu-west1 -> routing-v1. Executing now. :hammer_and_wrench:

deploy-bot: Rollback action: promoting pin for eu-west1 -> routing-v1 at 1776543250. Target now 100% in region. Notifying traffic-surgeon hooks.

mike.h: Post-rollback check: EU p95 dropped to ~90ms within 90s, synth pass rate back to baseline, kv_miss_rate back to nominal. Holding global rollout until root cause found.

alisha: Captured logs and traces, creating INF-243 to investigate prefill TTL mismatch + async worker backlog. Will attach flame graphs and sample traces.

sara: Thanks. I'll update the release notes: add Known Issue entry and mark routing-v2 rollback in the changelog. Reopen rollout after fix + canary rerun. :white_check_mark:

mike.h: Closing this smoke thread for now. Follow-up: INF-243 (triage), and PR with staged canary checklist to include KV prefill validation. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
